story:
In a big, bright elementary school, there was a little girl named Soomin. She had a shiny new lunchbox with colorful cats on it. Soomin loved her lunchbox and filled it with yummy sandwiches, juicy apples, and sweet cookies. But when she went to get it from the classroom, oh no! Her lunchbox was gone! "Where's my lunchbox?" Soomin asked her teacher, Mrs. Kim. Mrs. Kim said, "Don't worry, we'll find it!" 

Soomin's friend, Emma, heard about the missing lunchbox and said, "I want to help you find it!" They looked high and low, under big tables and behind happy chairs. They even asked their class pet, a fluffy rabbit named Max, if he saw it. Max twitched his little nose and hopped around, but didn't say anything. Soomin and Emma laughed and said, "Maybe Max is just being silly!" 

As they searched, they found many other lunchboxes - big ones, small ones, red ones, and blue ones. But none of them were Soomin's. Just when they were about to give up, Emma had an idea. "Let's look in the playground!" she exclaimed. And there, under a big slide, they found Soomin's lunchbox! It was a little dirty, but still shiny and new-looking. Soomin was so happy and thanked Emma for her help. Mrs. Kim smiled and said, "Teamwork makes the dream work!" Soomin learned that even when things seem lost, friends can help you find them, and being kind and working together is the best way to solve any problem.
